compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Create synthetic regression fixtures representing PR #102 cycle 2's 'new file' findings and write a replay test asserting they would be auto-downgraded under the novelty gate.

## Files to create
- tests/fixtures/pr-102-cycle-2-new-file-findings.jsonl — ~8-12 findings on files NOT in any cycle-1 defense: ticket-init.sh, ticket-exists.sh, test-batched.sh, test-detect-stack.sh. Each finding has relation=NEW_INTRODUCED, no escape_rationale, with cited_lines on those files.
- tests/fixtures/pr-102-cycle-1-defenses.jsonl — subset of cycle-1 defenses covering only runner.py, merge-to-main-pr.sh, sprint-story-review.yml (NOT the new files above). Can be shared with Story A's fixture if already created.
- Add replay test to tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_novelty_gate.py

## Replay test
test_pr102_new_file_findings_all_downgraded: load fixtures, call _apply_novelty_gate(new_file_findings, cycle1_defenses, diff_text='', cycle_number=2), assert 100% of findings are downgraded (no proximity overlap, no escape_rationale).

## Acceptance
- Fixture files exist with valid JSONL (each line valid JSON)
- Replay test exists and currently fails (function not implemented)
- Note: 100% is the design target since these synthetic fixtures are specifically 'new file with no escape_rationale'
